claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows brand text reading 'AIG BROTHER', not 'Ambro Brother', and no embroidery hoop/unit is visible; this reads as a standard industrial sewing machine head, not an embroidery machine.
No stress test, long-use footage, or structural detail shown; subjective condition claim cannot be confirmed from a single static photo.
No stitching sample or running demonstration shown in the report.

risks.risk: Motor/working condition unknown - machine may not power on or stitch properly
risks.proof: Video of machine plugged in, running, and stitching a test seam

risks.risk: Small plate with model/spec text is blurred - true model and specs unconfirmed
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate

risks.risk: Completeness of motor, pedal, clutch and wiring not shown
risks.proof: Photo of underside and pedal assembly, plus wiring/plug close-up

risks.risk: Accessories (bobbins, extra needles, oil, manual) not confirmed included
risks.proof: Photo of accessory kit laid out next to machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare head only, no accessories

risks.risk: Age and usage history unknown, dust/thread residue suggests prior heavy use
risks.proof: Photos of serial number area and any maintenance/purchase records
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, older unit

risks.risk: Table/stand sturdiness and whether it's included in the sale is unclear
risks.proof: Photo showing full table/stand with confirmation it's part of the sale

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate showing exact brand and model
Video of the machine powered on and stitching a test seam
Photo of the underside showing motor, pedal, and clutch assembly
Photo of wiring and plug condition
Photo of any included accessories (bobbins, needles, oil, manual)
Confirmation and photo of whether the table/stand is included
response.reason: The witness positively identified an industrial sewing machine, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified brand, no demonstrated function, possible missing accessories/table), with upside pending the listed proofs.
